thread:
Diego Alvarez: hey all, acute newbie here — first oncall shift tonight. two quick blockers: 1) I can't ack PagerDuty alerts from my laptop (keeps saying SSO token expired), and 2) the private metrics dashboard 401s unless I'm on VPN. anyone available for a quick handoff?
Priya Nair: welcome Diego :wave: For the SSO token prob, try `okta-aws login` or re-auth via Okta browser and then open PagerDuty in that same browser. Mobile ack should still work as a fallback. Which VPN are you using?
Diego Alvarez: i'm on personal wifi, using the old 'openvpn' profile from the docs. error in browser: 401 Unauthorized when loading https://metrics.redwood.com/private
Ethan Brooks: we migrated to the new wireguard profile (redwood-vpn) last quarter. open the Access site -> VPN -> Download WG config. Also run `okta-verify push` if the browser session expires.
Zoe Kim: if you need immediate ack and can't reauth, mobile PD + reply with "ack" works. But for debugging run `kubectl auth can-i get pods --namespace infra-metrics` to check cluster RBAC (if you need to tail logs).
Diego Alvarez: ran `kubectl auth can-i get pods --namespace infra-metrics` -> "no". that explains lack of access to the metrics exporter.
Priya Nair: I'll grant read access to infra-metrics and add you to the Okta group that maps to `k8s-readers`. give me a minute.
Oncall Bot: Scheduled training: Incident Sim 101 (shadow) at 20:00 PT tonight. Attendance recommended for new oncalls.
Priya Nair: done — you should have `view` on infra-metrics now. try the kubectl command again. also wireguard config sent to your email.
Diego Alvarez: kubectl now returns "yes". metrics dashboard loads after connecting to redwood-vpn. PagerDuty web ack works after Okta push. thanks!
Ethan Brooks: quick escalation guide we use: 1) Acknowledge in PD, 2) run `runbook lookup <svc>` and paste the short summary to #incidents, 3) if unresolved after 10m escalate to L2 by running `esc escalate --svc <svc> --level L2` (or ping @sre-leads), 4) for customer-impacting SEV1 call the incident commander and page the SRE rotation. We'll walk through the commands in the shadow session.
Diego Alvarez: what's the canonical place for the escalation matrix?
Zoe Kim: runbooks repo -> docs/escalation-matrix.md and Confluence -> Oncall Playbook. Also check the pinned msg in #eng-sre for phone numbers.
Diego Alvarez: got it. one more: during the simulated outage lab do we need to create a postmortem? or is that only for real incidents?
Priya Nair: for sims, we do a short retro in the lab doc, not a full blameless postmortem. Real SEV1/SEV2 get full postmortems per the postmortem template.
Diego Alvarez: awesome. appreciate the rapid help. looking forward to the shadow shift tonight. :raised_hands:
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete "Oncall Shadow Lab" and "Incident Comms" micro-course before your second live shift to get escalation privileges.
